stem: A region has a very large number of endemic species but has lost very little of its natural habitat. Why would it NOT qualify as a biodiversity hotspot?

stem: Which statement best explains how the biodiversity we see today came about?
options: All present-day species appeared at one time long ago
Organisms changed their form on purpose in one lifetime
Species stayed the same while only habitats changed
Small helpful differences built up over many generations
explanation: Correct option: (D). The chapter explains that small differences among individuals affected survival and reproduction, and these accumulated over many generations to give new forms of life. Species did not all appear at once, organisms cannot change on purpose within one lifetime, and species have not remained unchanged.

They live in both salt water and fresh water
They have both xylem and phloem in stems

stem: Which sequence correctly shows the order in which plant groups became less dependent on water for reproduction?

stem: A starfish has a hard internal skeleton but is still classified as an invertebrate. Which reasoning is correct?
options: It lacks a notochord, the basis for being a chordate
Its skeleton is of bone, found only in invertebrates
It has a backbone, but its body is not segmented

They are in the same genus but are different species
